# Auto-generated by Phase Diagram Agent LAMMPS runtime
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

variable initTemp equal 300
variable targetTemp equal 300
variable runSteps equal 6000
variable boxSize equal 4

lattice fcc 3.52
region box block 0 4 0 4 0 4
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 58.6934

pair_style eam
pair_coeff 1 1 /opt/homebrew/share/lammps/potentials/Ni_u3.eam

neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 10 check yes
timestep 0.001
velocity all create 300 4928459 mom yes rot yes dist gaussian
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press
dump 1 all custom 60 dump.atom id type xu yu zu x y z
dump_modify 1 sort id
fix 1 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 6000
